slides.title: ReadySet Control Tower
slides.notes: Independent feedback on fixed commit 4dd07736e99f96dd46cb6199c32bea32465bd20e. No official score.

slides.title: What we actually tested
slides.fix: 10 browser checks passed. TypeScript and production build passed.
slides.notes: The independent checks intentionally target suspected gaps. These denominators measure different things and do not form an accuracy score. Two independent controls passed.

slides.title: The working workflow
slides.notes: A1 changes, A2 remains unrelated. Browser screenshot uses invented samples only.

slides.title: 1 · Empty inputs return Ready
slides.fix: Required-input validation must run before the hash shortcut.
slides.notes: Four probes: empty folders, both required inputs absent, identical zero-byte files and identical invalid bytes all return Ready. Neither analysis reruns.

slides.title: 2 · Baseline quality stays unknown
slides.fix: Separate baseline fitness from new-change compatibility.
slides.notes: The documented engine is change-only. This is a scope boundary, not proof the detector violates its narrow contract. Broad readiness wording needs an explicit trusted-baseline receipt.

slides.title: 3 · No measurements remain
slides.fix: Report measured denominators and analysis availability.
slides.notes: The all-blank ERALPHA row yields null group means and null difference. Proposed acceptance: Blocked or Insufficient Evidence with the unavailable analysis explained.

slides.title: 4a · Display rounding hides change
slides.fix: Keep full precision until display formatting.
slides.notes: The positive-group mean changes by 0.0004. The helper receives equal rounded outputs and reports no effect. The detector may still see source changes. This is an effect-classification limitation.

slides.title: 4b · Zero has no relative denominator
slides.fix: Show absolute change when the baseline is zero.
slides.notes: The helper substitutes 1.0 for zero or nonnumeric baselines. This does not establish a mathematical 100% change. Use explicit undefined relative change and justified absolute tolerance.

slides.title: 4c · Count loss deserves its own check
slides.fix: Assess adequacy independently of a stable estimate.
slides.notes: Helper-only probe: the difference remains 2.9, while count drops by 99.9%. This is not a full real-data cohort run. A statistician should set task-specific adequacy criteria.

slides.title: 5 · Timestamps change the answer
slides.notes: Same file contents in both runs; only modification times changed. The candidate-selection rule chooses the newest file. Reject conflicts or record explicit selection.

slides.title: 6 · A blank reviewer is accepted
slides.before:
Direct API request
No reviewer name
slides.fix: Enforce reviewer validation on the server.
slides.notes: The UI correctly requires a name. The direct loopback API accepts confirmed plus approved without one. This is not a claim of remote exploitation.

slides.title: 7 · Clearing erases the record
slides.fix: Preserve an event for every change and withdrawal.
slides.notes: The current-state dictionary overwrites and removes records. Comparison history is separate and also replaces prior state. Evidence fingerprints are a strength to retain.

slides.title: Cloud routing already has disclosure
slides.after:
No findings attached
No live API call
slides.fix: Add a warning against confidential text in questions.
slides.notes: Corrected earlier suspicion: the UI explicitly discloses Anthropic routing. No missing-disclosure or actual-leak claim is supported. Provider safeguards are prospective improvements.

slides.title: The proposed repair sequence
slides.fix: Then refine precision, zero handling and adequacy.
slides.notes: Use the detailed report for acceptance checks and source lines. Preserve the efficient change detector, evidence links and question-specific behavior.

slides.title: The next review needs real evidence
slides.fix: Unseen-input performance and clinical validity remain unverified.
slides.notes: Frozen public A versus itself returned Ready with zero findings through the identical-file shortcut. No sealed judging input or clinical validity was tested.
